description: Core permissions for the clinical workstation window. Without this the app grants no core permissions at all, so `listen()` for the telemetry stream is denied and the live overlay silently never receives data. `updater:default` lets the UI check and install a release; `process:default` provides the relaunch that follows an install. The window entries cover the custom title bar: `allow-start-dragging` is NOT part of `core:window:default`, so the header drag region is denied without it; the minimize / toggle-maximize / close permissions cover the title bar buttons.
